behaviours.name: Shows up consistently
behaviours.definition: Delivers reliably and models commitment, especially when it counts.

foundations.expectation: Does what’s asked, shows dependability, and follows through.

ratings.needs-work: Commitments are missed or completed inconsistently. Requires reminders, communicates late, or becomes unreliable when pressure increases.
ratings.great: Does what’s asked, shows dependability, and follows through. Communicates early when a commitment is at risk.
ratings.smashing-it: Anticipates commitments, plans ahead, and follows through without prompting. Helps others deliver reliably and strengthens confidence in the team.

momentum.expectation: Leads by example and keeps standards high, even under pressure.

ratings.needs-work: Personal standards fluctuate and the team sees inconsistent follow through. Pressure leads to lowered expectations, avoidable delays, or unhelpful shortcuts.
ratings.great: Leads by example and keeps standards high, even under pressure. Reinforces reliable delivery across the team.
ratings.smashing-it: Creates practical routines that improve team reliability, addresses slippage early, and maintains high standards without creating unnecessary pressure or dependency.

enterprise.expectation: Designs systems, rhythms, and expectations that create consistent performance and reliability at scale.

ratings.needs-work: Reliability depends on individual effort or heroics. Expectations and operating rhythms vary across teams, creating inconsistent outcomes.
ratings.great: Designs systems, rhythms, and expectations that create consistent performance and reliability at scale.
ratings.smashing-it: Uses data and feedback to strengthen reliability across the business, removes recurring points of failure, and reduces variation without creating excessive bureaucracy.

behaviours.name: Owns the outcome
behaviours.definition: Takes responsibility for results and stays accountable through consequences.

foundations.expectation: Steps up to own results and fix what isn’t working.

ratings.needs-work: Waits for others to solve problems, focuses on blame, or stops once their immediate task is complete. Issues remain unresolved.
ratings.great: Steps up to own results and fix what isn’t working. Follows the issue through to a clear outcome.
ratings.smashing-it: Takes ownership early, identifies the underlying cause, fixes the issue, and shares the learning so the same problem is less likely to recur.

momentum.expectation: Holds self and others to commitments and sees things through.

ratings.needs-work: Accountability is inconsistent. Avoids difficult follow up, accepts incomplete delivery, or does not address missed commitments within the team.
ratings.great: Holds self and others to commitments and sees things through. Makes ownership and follow up clear.
ratings.smashing-it: Creates strong accountability without blame, removes barriers to delivery, and uses missed commitments to improve expectations, capability, and team systems.

enterprise.expectation: Owns complex, long term outcomes and makes deliberate trade offs that protect customer trust and business integrity.

ratings.needs-work: Focuses on local or short term results while avoiding difficult enterprise trade offs. Consequences for customers, risk, or integrity are addressed too late.
ratings.great: Owns complex, long term outcomes and makes deliberate trade offs that protect customer trust and business integrity.
ratings.smashing-it: Anticipates second order consequences, communicates trade offs transparently, and embeds learning into strategy, governance, and future decisions.

behaviours.name: Sets shared expectations
behaviours.definition: Connects purpose, priorities, roles, and standards so people understand what good looks like and how to deliver it.

foundations.expectation: Asks thoughtful questions and checks for shared understanding before moving forward.

ratings.needs-work: Assumes others understand, leaves roles or outcomes unclear, or begins work without confirming expectations. Rework and confusion result.
ratings.great: Asks thoughtful questions and checks for shared understanding before moving forward.
ratings.smashing-it: Clarifies outcomes, roles, timeframes, and constraints, then checks understanding and adjusts the approach before confusion becomes a problem.

momentum.expectation: Defines what success looks like and aligns the team around clear priorities and standards.

ratings.needs-work: Priorities or standards are vague, conflicting, or frequently changed without explanation. Team members interpret success differently.
ratings.great: Defines what success looks like and aligns the team around clear priorities and standards.
ratings.smashing-it: Translates priorities into practical measures, ownership, and operating rhythms, and resolves ambiguity or competing expectations early.

enterprise.expectation: Connects purpose and strategy to clear, non negotiable expectations, systems, and leadership behaviour so people understand the direction and act consistently.

ratings.needs-work: Purpose and strategy are not translated into consistent expectations. Standards vary across functions, messages conflict, or people cannot see how their work connects to direction.
ratings.great: Connects purpose and strategy to clear, non negotiable expectations, systems, and leadership behaviour so people understand the direction and act consistently.
ratings.smashing-it: Builds a compelling line of sight from purpose and strategy to measures, governance, systems, and leadership practice, tests understanding, and corrects drift early.

behaviours.name: Communicates with clarity
behaviours.definition: Shares information clearly and appropriately so people stay aligned, informed, and able to act.

foundations.expectation: Explains ideas clearly and checks understanding in everyday interactions.

ratings.needs-work: Information is unclear, incomplete, late, or overly complicated. Does not check whether others understand what is required.
ratings.great: Explains ideas clearly and checks understanding in everyday interactions.
ratings.smashing-it: Communicates concisely, confirms actions and ownership, and adapts the level of detail so others can act confidently.

momentum.expectation: Adjusts message and style to suit the audience, keeping teams aligned and informed.

ratings.needs-work: Uses the same message for every audience or communicates in a way that creates unnecessary confusion, overload, or misalignment.
ratings.great: Adjusts message and style to suit the audience, keeping teams aligned and informed.
ratings.smashing-it: Anticipates information needs, makes complex issues easy to understand, and uses the right channel and timing to maintain alignment.

enterprise.expectation: Shapes communication across teams and functions, creating a clear and consistent narrative that supports strategic alignment and action.

ratings.needs-work: Communication is fragmented or overly tactical. Different groups receive competing messages, trade offs are obscured, or people cannot translate the message into coordinated action.
ratings.great: Shapes communication across teams and functions, creating a clear and consistent narrative that supports strategic alignment and action.
ratings.smashing-it: Creates a coherent organisational narrative, surfaces trade offs clearly, equips leaders to carry the message consistently, and establishes communication rhythms that support fast, aligned decisions.

behaviours.name: Resolves conflict
behaviours.definition: Addresses tension constructively to maintain trust, progress, and productive working relationships.

foundations.expectation: Listens with empathy, raises issues early, and seeks support to resolve them.

ratings.needs-work: Avoids tension, lets issues build, reacts emotionally, or discusses the problem with others rather than addressing it appropriately.
ratings.great: Listens with empathy, raises issues early, and seeks support to resolve them.
ratings.smashing-it: Raises concerns respectfully, listens for the underlying issue, contributes to a fair resolution, and follows up to confirm the relationship and work are back on track.

momentum.expectation: Addresses conflict directly and fairly, balancing honesty with respect to keep teams aligned and productive.

ratings.needs-work: Delays difficult conversations, takes sides, or handles similar conflicts inconsistently. The issue continues to affect performance or trust.
ratings.great: Addresses conflict directly and fairly, balancing honesty with respect to keep teams aligned and productive.
ratings.smashing-it: Facilitates productive challenge, addresses root causes rather than symptoms, and restores clarity, accountability, and trust after conflict.

enterprise.expectation: Creates conditions where healthy challenge is expected, conflict is addressed early, and trust is maintained across teams or functions.

ratings.needs-work: Cross functional tension is tolerated, politicised, or repeatedly escalated without resolution. Structural causes are left unchanged.
ratings.great: Creates conditions where healthy challenge is expected, conflict is addressed early, and trust is maintained across teams or functions.
ratings.smashing-it: Builds organisational capability and mechanisms for constructive disagreement, identifies recurring conflict patterns, and changes systems that create avoidable friction.

behaviours.name: Strengthens team culture
behaviours.definition: Builds relationships and environments where people feel connected, supported, and able to do their best work.

foundations.expectation: Contributes positively to team relationships and ways of working.

ratings.needs-work: Is passive or negative about team culture, excludes others, or behaves in ways that reduce trust, cooperation, or psychological safety.
ratings.great: Contributes positively to team relationships and ways of working.
ratings.smashing-it: Models inclusion, supports colleagues, reinforces useful team norms, and helps create an environment where people can contribute confidently.

momentum.expectation: Builds trust within the team and addresses behaviours that undermine performance or inclusion.

ratings.needs-work: Ignores behaviours that damage trust or inclusion, relies on informal goodwill, or allows standards to vary across the team.
ratings.great: Builds trust within the team and addresses behaviours that undermine performance or inclusion.
ratings.smashing-it: Deliberately shapes team rituals, standards, and feedback, and builds shared ownership for a healthy, accountable culture.

enterprise.expectation: Builds relationships and uses organisational influence across functions to align stakeholders, resolve barriers, and deliberately shape a collaborative, high performing culture at scale.

ratings.needs-work: Culture is treated as messaging, relationships are narrow, stakeholder dynamics are ignored, and cross functional barriers or political friction repeatedly undermine outcomes.
ratings.great: Builds relationships and uses organisational influence across functions to align stakeholders, resolve barriers, and deliberately shape a collaborative, high performing culture at scale.
ratings.smashing-it: Builds influential networks, aligns incentives and leadership systems, measures culture drivers, and mobilises stakeholders across boundaries around shared outcomes.

behaviours.name: Keeps going
behaviours.definition: Pushes through challenges and keeps things moving, even when the next step isn’t obvious.

foundations.expectation: Pushes through setbacks and follows things through to the end.

ratings.needs-work: Gives up too quickly, loses focus after setbacks, or leaves work unfinished when the path becomes difficult or unclear.
ratings.great: Pushes through setbacks and follows things through to the end.
ratings.smashing-it: Stays steady, adjusts the plan when needed, seeks help early, and closes the loop even when the work becomes difficult.

momentum.expectation: Balances focus with flexibility when priorities shift.

ratings.needs-work: Becomes rigid or reactive when priorities change. The team experiences confusion, unnecessary churn, or loss of momentum.
ratings.great: Balances focus with flexibility when priorities shift.
ratings.smashing-it: Helps the team reprioritise calmly, protects essential outcomes, and adapts the plan without losing accountability or creating avoidable disruption.

enterprise.expectation: Sustains momentum through prolonged complexity or uncertainty and prevents disruption to performance at scale.

ratings.needs-work: Prolonged complexity creates strategic drift, reactive decisions, or sustained overload. Performance depends on repeated crisis responses.
ratings.great: Sustains momentum through prolonged complexity or uncertainty and prevents disruption to performance at scale.
ratings.smashing-it: Anticipates pressure points, sequences decisions deliberately, protects organisational capacity, and preserves strategic focus through extended uncertainty.

behaviours.name: Lifts others
behaviours.definition: Provides steadiness and confidence to others, especially during pressure or uncertainty.

foundations.expectation: Stays positive and encourages teammates.

ratings.needs-work: Passes stress to others, focuses mainly on what is going wrong, or withdraws support when pressure increases.
ratings.great: Stays positive and encourages teammates.
ratings.smashing-it: Notices when others are struggling, offers practical support, and recognises progress without minimising genuine challenges.

momentum.expectation: Builds belief in others and celebrates progress.

ratings.needs-work: Motivation is inconsistent or relies on generic encouragement. Pressure reduces confidence, ownership, or energy across the team.
ratings.great: Builds belief in others and celebrates progress.
ratings.smashing-it: Builds confidence through clear context, coaching, recognition, and meaningful ownership, especially when results are difficult.

enterprise.expectation: Creates stability and focus through visible leadership during sustained pressure or change.

ratings.needs-work: Leadership is invisible or inconsistent during major change. Messages lack credibility or fail to create confidence and focus.
ratings.great: Creates stability and focus through visible leadership during sustained pressure or change.
ratings.smashing-it: Sustains confidence across the business through transparent communication, visible decisions, practical support systems, and consistent leadership behaviour.

behaviours.name: Finds a way
behaviours.definition: Removes obstacles and adapts approaches to keep progress moving.

foundations.expectation: Looks for ways around small roadblocks.

ratings.needs-work: Waits for someone else to solve routine obstacles, repeats an approach that is not working, or stops without escalating appropriately.
ratings.great: Looks for ways around small roadblocks.
ratings.smashing-it: Tests practical alternatives, uses available resources, escalates with useful context, and shares solutions that may help others.

momentum.expectation: Removes obstacles so the team can keep moving.

ratings.needs-work: Accepts barriers as fixed, removes only immediate symptoms, or allows recurring obstacles to consume team time and energy.
ratings.great: Removes obstacles so the team can keep moving.
ratings.smashing-it: Coordinates resources, addresses root causes, and improves processes so the same barrier is less likely to recur.

enterprise.expectation: Anticipates systemic barriers and reshapes conditions so progress can continue across teams, functions, or markets.

ratings.needs-work: Systemic barriers remain in place while teams rely on local workarounds. Constraints are shifted between functions rather than resolved.
ratings.great: Anticipates systemic barriers and reshapes conditions so progress can continue across teams, functions, or markets.
ratings.smashing-it: Redesigns structures, policies, or investment decisions to remove systemic constraints and tracks whether progress improves without creating new barriers elsewhere.

behaviours.name: Asks and explores
behaviours.definition: Uses curiosity, questions, insight, and external perspective to understand the bigger picture and explore what is possible.

foundations.expectation: Seeks to understand by asking questions and testing ideas.

ratings.needs-work: Assumes, relies on the first answer, or asks questions without using the information.
ratings.great: Seeks relevant perspectives and tests assumptions before acting.
ratings.smashing-it: Identifies emerging patterns, connects insight across areas and creates better questions for others.

momentum.expectation: Shares insights and connects dots to improve work.

ratings.needs-work: Assumes, relies on the first answer, or asks questions without using the information.
ratings.great: Seeks relevant perspectives and tests assumptions before acting.
ratings.smashing-it: Identifies emerging patterns, connects insight across areas and creates better questions for others.

enterprise.expectation: Scans customer, market, regulatory, technology, and emerging business trends to identify future risks and opportunities and inform strategic choices.

ratings.needs-work: Assumes, relies on the first answer, or asks questions without using the information.
ratings.great: Seeks relevant perspectives and tests assumptions before acting.
ratings.smashing-it: Identifies emerging patterns, connects insight across areas and creates better questions for others.

behaviours.name: Challenges the norm
behaviours.definition: Questions assumptions and existing practices to find better ways forward.

foundations.expectation: Brings fresh thinking and voices ideas that could make things better.

ratings.needs-work: Accepts inefficient practice, complains without proposing a solution, or avoids raising concerns.
ratings.great: Constructively questions processes and suggests practical improvements.
ratings.smashing-it: Leads thoughtful challenge to entrenched practices and helps others test better ways of working.

momentum.expectation: Tests assumptions and takes smart risks to spark progress.

ratings.needs-work: Accepts inefficient practice, complains without proposing a solution, or avoids raising concerns.
ratings.great: Constructively questions processes and suggests practical improvements.
ratings.smashing-it: Leads thoughtful challenge to entrenched practices and helps others test better ways of working.

enterprise.expectation: Challenges entrenched thinking and redirects effort or investment to improve future outcomes at scale.

ratings.needs-work: Accepts inefficient practice, complains without proposing a solution, or avoids raising concerns.
ratings.great: Constructively questions processes and suggests practical improvements.
ratings.smashing-it: Leads thoughtful challenge to entrenched practices and helps others test better ways of working.

behaviours.name: Learns and adapts
behaviours.definition: Uses feedback, reflection, experimentation, and learning to understand their impact and adapt how they work.

foundations.expectation: Seeks feedback, recognises strengths and development gaps, and applies learning to improve.

ratings.needs-work: Repeats ineffective approaches, resists feedback or treats setbacks as someone else's issue.
ratings.great: Seeks feedback, applies learning and changes approach when evidence requires it.
ratings.smashing-it: Builds learning loops for others and adapts direction early in response to new information.

momentum.expectation: Reflects on their impact, adapts their leadership approach, and models continuous learning for the team.

ratings.needs-work: Repeats ineffective approaches, resists feedback or treats setbacks as someone else's issue.
ratings.great: Seeks feedback, applies learning and changes approach when evidence requires it.
ratings.smashing-it: Builds learning loops for others and adapts direction early in response to new information.

enterprise.expectation: Builds an adaptive learning culture, tests strategic assumptions, and evolves leadership practices as conditions change.

ratings.needs-work: Repeats ineffective approaches, resists feedback or treats setbacks as someone else's issue.
ratings.great: Seeks feedback, applies learning and changes approach when evidence requires it.
ratings.smashing-it: Builds learning loops for others and adapts direction early in response to new information.

behaviours.name: Values differences
behaviours.definition: Respects diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to create inclusive teams where everyone can contribute.

foundations.expectation: Is respectful of others’ views, even when different from their own.

ratings.needs-work: Dismisses, interrupts, or excludes different perspectives, or becomes defensive when others challenge their view.
ratings.great: Is respectful of others’ views, even when different from their own.
ratings.smashing-it: Actively seeks different perspectives, changes their view when evidence supports it, and helps others contribute safely and confidently.

momentum.expectation: Invites different perspectives to broaden thinking and decisions.

ratings.needs-work: Consults the same voices, treats inclusion as a formality, or gathers input without allowing it to influence the decision.
ratings.great: Invites different perspectives to broaden thinking and decisions.
ratings.smashing-it: Designs inclusive decision processes, addresses bias or unequal participation, and shows how diverse input improved the outcome.

enterprise.expectation: Builds environments where diverse perspectives are actively used to improve decision quality and reduce bias at scale.

ratings.needs-work: Diversity is treated symbolically rather than embedded in governance, talent, strategy, or decision processes.
ratings.great: Builds environments where diverse perspectives are actively used to improve decision quality and reduce bias at scale.
ratings.smashing-it: Embeds diverse input into governance, data, workforce, and strategic decisions, and measures whether decision quality and equity outcomes improve.

behaviours.name: Makes ethical decisions
behaviours.definition: Uses integrity and sound judgement to do what is right, even when choices are complex or uncomfortable.

foundations.expectation: Acts with integrity and checks decisions align with our standards.

ratings.needs-work: Ignores standards, hides concerns, takes convenient shortcuts, or proceeds despite uncertainty without checking what is right.
ratings.great: Acts with integrity and checks decisions align with our standards.
ratings.smashing-it: Identifies conflicts early, seeks appropriate advice, documents the rationale, and speaks up when a decision may not meet the organisation’s standards.

momentum.expectation: Navigates grey areas using judgement, facts, and values.

ratings.needs-work: Applies values inconsistently in grey areas or allows delivery pressure, relationships, or personal preference to override sound judgement.
ratings.great: Navigates grey areas using judgement, facts, and values.
ratings.smashing-it: Creates a transparent decision process, balances evidence and values, and helps others make principled decisions without avoiding accountability.

enterprise.expectation: Sets ethical boundaries for the business and supports leaders to make principled decisions under pressure and uncertainty.

ratings.needs-work: Ethical boundaries and escalation paths are unclear, or exceptions are normalised when pressure increases.
ratings.great: Sets ethical boundaries for the business and supports leaders to make principled decisions under pressure and uncertainty.
ratings.smashing-it: Embeds ethical governance, tests the broader consequences of decisions, learns from near misses, and maintains integrity when the commercial pressure is highest.

behaviours.name: Shows empathy
behaviours.definition: Considers the human impact of decisions and leads with care and respect.

foundations.expectation: Shows empathy, listens without judgement, and includes others in daily interactions.

ratings.needs-work: Interrupts, judges, overlooks personal impact, or responds in a way that makes others less willing to speak openly.
ratings.great: Shows empathy, listens without judgement, and includes others in daily interactions.
ratings.smashing-it: Listens for what is said and unsaid, adapts support to the person, and checks whether the interaction led to a respectful and useful outcome.

momentum.expectation: Adapts behaviour to meet people where they are, ensuring diverse perspectives shape team decisions.

ratings.needs-work: Uses a one size fits all approach, or shows empathy without maintaining clear standards, accountability, and fair treatment.
ratings.great: Adapts behaviour to meet people where they are, ensuring diverse perspectives shape team decisions.
ratings.smashing-it: Balances care, clarity, and accountability, and ensures team decisions reflect the genuine needs and perspectives of affected people.

enterprise.expectation: Balances empathy with accountability, ensuring decisions are fair, humane, and sustainable across teams or communities.

ratings.needs-work: Major decisions are detached from human impact or produce uneven consequences that are identified only after implementation.
ratings.great: Balances empathy with accountability, ensuring decisions are fair, humane, and sustainable across teams or communities.
ratings.smashing-it: Uses impact assessment and stakeholder feedback to design humane, sustainable decisions, and acts early where outcomes are unfair or disproportionately harmful.

behaviours.name: Leads the employee lifecycle
behaviours.definition: Brings people into the business, supports them to succeed, and manages transitions well.

foundations.expectation: Understands the stages of the lifecycle and supports basic processes where directed.

ratings.needs-work: Has limited awareness of lifecycle requirements, misses process steps, or provides poor handovers during onboarding, development, or transition activities.
ratings.great: Understands the stages of the lifecycle and supports basic processes where directed.
ratings.smashing-it: Prepares well, completes lifecycle tasks accurately and on time, and helps people understand what to expect during key transitions.

momentum.expectation: Manages hiring, onboarding, development, and exits to maintain team stability and capability.

ratings.needs-work: Hiring, onboarding, development, or exit practices are inconsistent and create avoidable capability, experience, or compliance gaps.
ratings.great: Manages hiring, onboarding, development, and exits to maintain team stability and capability.
ratings.smashing-it: Uses feedback and people data to improve lifecycle quality, addresses recurring experience or capability gaps, and plans transitions before they become disruptive.

enterprise.expectation: Designs and improves people practices and workforce planning to support sustainable capability across the business.

ratings.needs-work: Workforce planning is reactive and people practices are fragmented across the business. Future capability needs are not translated into action.
ratings.great: Designs and improves people practices and workforce planning to support sustainable capability across the business.
ratings.smashing-it: Anticipates future skills and workforce shifts, integrates talent and workforce planning, and measures whether people practices improve capability, mobility, and sustainability.

behaviours.name: Builds capability
behaviours.definition: Develops the skills and confidence people need to perform now and into the future.

foundations.expectation: Shares knowledge, gives useful feedback, and supports others to build confidence in core skills.

ratings.needs-work: Holds knowledge, gives vague or unhelpful feedback, or takes over tasks rather than supporting others to learn.
ratings.great: Shares knowledge, gives useful feedback, and supports others to build confidence in core skills.
ratings.smashing-it: Explains and demonstrates skills clearly, creates safe practice, checks understanding, and helps colleagues become more independent.

momentum.expectation: Coaches others, gives clear feedback, and builds capability within the team.

ratings.needs-work: Provides limited coaching, unclear feedback, or relies on personally fixing problems rather than building team capability.
ratings.great: Coaches others, gives clear feedback, and builds capability within the team.
ratings.smashing-it: Tailors coaching to individual needs, creates deliberate practice, tracks development over time, and increases independent performance across the team.

enterprise.expectation: Builds long term capability through succession planning, role design, and development pathways at scale.

ratings.needs-work: Capability planning is disconnected from strategy, succession depth is weak, and key roles depend on individual incumbents.
ratings.great: Builds long term capability through succession planning, role design, and development pathways at scale.
ratings.smashing-it: Links capability investment to strategic priorities, builds measurable readiness and mobility, and creates succession depth for critical future roles.

behaviours.name: Drives engagement
behaviours.definition: Creates conditions where people are motivated, accountable, and committed to their work.

foundations.expectation: Contributes positively to the team and takes responsibility for own engagement.

ratings.needs-work: Is consistently disengaged, cynical, or passive and places full responsibility for motivation on other people.
ratings.great: Contributes positively to the team and takes responsibility for own engagement.
ratings.smashing-it: Raises concerns constructively, supports team participation, and contributes energy and ownership even when conditions are not ideal.

momentum.expectation: Builds trust, addresses disengagement, and creates a team environment where people want to perform.

ratings.needs-work: Avoids signs of disengagement or relies mainly on messages, activities, or incentives without addressing the actual causes.
ratings.great: Builds trust, addresses disengagement, and creates a team environment where people want to perform.
ratings.smashing-it: Diagnoses engagement drivers, acts on what can be changed, follows up transparently, and strengthens both belonging and accountability.

enterprise.expectation: Shapes leadership practices, expectations, and systems that sustain engagement across teams or functions.

ratings.needs-work: Engagement is treated as an occasional survey or communication activity rather than an outcome of leadership, workload, systems, and decisions.
ratings.great: Shapes leadership practices, expectations, and systems that sustain engagement across teams or functions.
ratings.smashing-it: Aligns leadership routines, workload, recognition, employee voice, and systems, then uses evidence to sustain engagement through changing business conditions.

behaviours.name: Runs daily operations
behaviours.definition: Ensures day to day work is planned, organised, and delivered reliably.

foundations.expectation: Follows established processes and completes operational tasks as required.

ratings.needs-work: Processes are followed inconsistently, operational tasks are late or incomplete, or routine dependencies are overlooked.
ratings.great: Follows established processes and completes operational tasks as required.
ratings.smashing-it: Plans ahead, identifies routine dependencies, closes issues promptly, and suggests practical improvements to everyday work.

momentum.expectation: Plans and coordinates work so the team delivers reliably and issues are addressed quickly.

ratings.needs-work: Work is managed reactively, ownership is unclear, and recurring operational failures or bottlenecks are not addressed.
ratings.great: Plans and coordinates work so the team delivers reliably and issues are addressed quickly.
ratings.smashing-it: Creates clear operating rhythms, contingency plans, and continuous improvement routines that increase reliability and reduce avoidable escalation.

enterprise.expectation: Designs operating rhythms and structures that enable consistent execution across teams or locations.

ratings.needs-work: The operating model is fragmented and execution depends on local heroics. Similar teams or locations use incompatible rhythms and structures.
ratings.great: Designs operating rhythms and structures that enable consistent execution across teams or locations.
ratings.smashing-it: Simplifies and strengthens the operating model, standardises where it adds value, preserves necessary local flexibility, and measures execution reliability.

behaviours.name: Uses systems and data
behaviours.definition: Uses data, digital tools, systems, and information to support sound decisions and performance.

foundations.expectation: Uses required systems correctly, keeps information accurate, and uses basic data to support decisions.

ratings.needs-work: Uses required systems incorrectly or inconsistently, keeps unreliable information, or ignores available data when making routine decisions.
ratings.great: Uses required systems correctly, keeps information accurate, and uses basic data to support decisions.
ratings.smashing-it: Maintains high data quality, uses available information to identify issues, and helps others use systems safely and correctly.

momentum.expectation: Uses data and systems to track performance, test decisions, and improve how work is done.

ratings.needs-work: Produces reports without useful interpretation, relies mainly on intuition, or changes work without tracking whether the change helped.
ratings.great: Uses data and systems to track performance, test decisions, and improve how work is done.
ratings.smashing-it: Combines data with operational context, tests likely causes, uses digital tools appropriately, and tracks whether changes improve performance.

enterprise.expectation: Builds data and digital capability, adopts useful technology, and creates system discipline so decisions and performance are informed, comparable, and scalable.

ratings.needs-work: Data definitions, digital practices, and system adoption vary across functions. Decisions are unreliable and technology is added without clear value or adoption.
ratings.great: Builds data and digital capability, adopts useful technology, and creates system discipline so decisions and performance are informed, comparable, and scalable.
ratings.smashing-it: Establishes strong data governance and decision rhythms, improves adoption, and selectively scales technology that measurably improves judgement, customer outcomes, or productivity.

behaviours.name: Prioritises for impact
behaviours.definition: Focuses effort on what will make the biggest difference.

foundations.expectation: Manages time and tasks to meet priorities.

ratings.needs-work: Spends time on lower value activity, misses key deadlines, or does not raise conflicting priorities until delivery is already affected.
ratings.great: Manages time and tasks to meet priorities.
ratings.smashing-it: Clarifies what matters most, sequences work effectively, renegotiates early, and protects the outcomes with the greatest value or risk.

momentum.expectation: Balances competing demands and reallocates effort to what matters most.

ratings.needs-work: Spreads effort too thinly, changes priorities without clear trade offs, or keeps low value work active while critical outcomes slip.
ratings.great: Balances competing demands and reallocates effort to what matters most.
ratings.smashing-it: Uses impact, risk, and dependencies to allocate effort, stops or defers low value work, and communicates trade offs clearly.

enterprise.expectation: Sets clear priorities and trade offs so resources are focused on the highest impact outcomes.

ratings.needs-work: Strategic priorities proliferate, resources remain misaligned, and the organisation lacks the capacity to execute what has been committed.
ratings.great: Sets clear priorities and trade offs so resources are focused on the highest impact outcomes.
ratings.smashing-it: Links portfolio and resource decisions to strategy, revisits trade offs as conditions change, and actively stops work that no longer justifies its cost.

behaviours.name: Follows safety and compliance standards
behaviours.definition: Ensures required rules, policies, and practices are followed consistently.

foundations.expectation: Follows safety and compliance requirements in daily work.

ratings.needs-work: Takes shortcuts, is unaware of required standards, or does not report uncertainty, incidents, or non compliance promptly.
ratings.great: Follows safety and compliance requirements in daily work.
ratings.smashing-it: Models the standards, checks when unsure, raises concerns early, and helps others understand the safe and compliant way to work.

momentum.expectation: Monitors compliance and addresses issues to keep the team operating safely.

ratings.needs-work: Monitoring is inconsistent, compliance is treated as administration, or identified gaps are corrected temporarily without addressing the cause.
ratings.great: Monitors compliance and addresses issues to keep the team operating safely.
ratings.smashing-it: Builds routine checks, investigates recurring gaps, corrects root causes, and verifies that actions have genuinely improved safety and compliance.

enterprise.expectation: Sets clear expectations and systems that embed safety and compliance across the business.

ratings.needs-work: Policies, controls, and accountability are unclear or disconnected from how work is actually performed across the business.
ratings.great: Sets clear expectations and systems that embed safety and compliance across the business.
ratings.smashing-it: Integrates compliance into operating design, governance, assurance, and leadership accountability, and tests whether controls are effective in practice.

behaviours.name: Identifies and addresses risk early
behaviours.definition: Anticipates potential issues and acts before they escalate.

foundations.expectation: Raises risks or concerns when they are identified.

ratings.needs-work: Misses, withholds, or delays raising a risk, or reports it without enough information for others to act.
ratings.great: Raises risks or concerns when they are identified.
ratings.smashing-it: Notices early warning signs, records and escalates the risk with useful context, and suggests sensible immediate controls.

momentum.expectation: Assesses risk and takes action to reduce impact or prevent recurrence.

ratings.needs-work: Responds mainly after incidents, uses superficial assessments, or implements actions without checking whether risk has reduced.
ratings.great: Assesses risk and takes action to reduce impact or prevent recurrence.
ratings.smashing-it: Assesses likelihood and consequence, implements proportionate controls, assigns ownership, and reviews whether recurrence has been prevented.

enterprise.expectation: Builds risk awareness and controls so emerging risks are identified and managed at scale.

ratings.needs-work: Risk insight is fragmented, emerging risks lack ownership, and controls are added without a coherent view of enterprise exposure.
ratings.great: Builds risk awareness and controls so emerging risks are identified and managed at scale.
ratings.smashing-it: Creates horizon scanning, clear ownership, aggregated risk insight, and resilience testing so the business can act before emerging threats become material.

behaviours.name: Prevents harm to people and customers
behaviours.definition: Takes action to protect people, customers, and the business from harm.

foundations.expectation: Acts safely and supports others to do the same.

ratings.needs-work: Acts unsafely, stays silent when others are at risk, or assumes someone else will intervene.
ratings.great: Acts safely and supports others to do the same.
ratings.smashing-it: Intervenes respectfully, secures the immediate situation, reports what occurred, and follows through until the risk is controlled.

momentum.expectation: Intervenes when safety or customer protection is at risk.

ratings.needs-work: Delays intervention because of delivery pressure, applies protection standards inconsistently, or addresses the incident without removing the cause.
ratings.great: Intervenes when safety or customer protection is at risk.
ratings.smashing-it: Empowers immediate action, coordinates an effective response, removes root causes, and turns incidents or near misses into team learning.

enterprise.expectation: Designs safeguards and decision frameworks that prevent harm across teams, locations, or markets.

ratings.needs-work: Safeguards are designed mainly after harm occurs and vary across the business. Decisions rely on individual judgement without sufficient protection.
ratings.great: Designs safeguards and decision frameworks that prevent harm across teams, locations, or markets.
ratings.smashing-it: Builds layered controls, stress tests safeguards, monitors leading indicators, and adapts the operating model before changing conditions create harm.

behaviours.name: Understands customer needs
behaviours.definition: Seeks to understand what customers need and what fairness looks like in practice.

foundations.expectation: Listens to customers and follows customer focused practices.

ratings.needs-work: Assumes what the customer needs, does not listen carefully, or applies a process without understanding the customer’s situation.
ratings.great: Listens to customers and follows customer focused practices.
ratings.smashing-it: Asks useful questions, clarifies the need, explains realistic options, and captures feedback that could improve the experience.

momentum.expectation: Uses customer insight to guide decisions and improve how the team operates.

ratings.needs-work: Treats customer feedback as isolated anecdotes or makes decisions mainly from an internal operational perspective.
ratings.great: Uses customer insight to guide decisions and improve how the team operates.
ratings.smashing-it: Synthesises customer feedback and performance evidence, identifies patterns or segments, changes team practices, and checks whether the experience improves.

enterprise.expectation: Builds customer insight into strategy, systems, and decision making across the business.

ratings.needs-work: Customer insight is ad hoc, delayed, or absent from strategy, investment, and governance decisions.
ratings.great: Builds customer insight into strategy, systems, and decision making across the business.
ratings.smashing-it: Creates reliable customer insight loops, embeds them into planning and investment, and tracks whether strategic choices strengthen trust and customer outcomes.

behaviours.name: Delivers fair, consistent experiences
behaviours.definition: Ensures customers experience the business in a reliable and fair way.

foundations.expectation: Follows processes so customers are treated consistently.

ratings.needs-work: Applies processes inconsistently, takes shortcuts, or treats similar customers differently without a sound reason.
ratings.great: Follows processes so customers are treated consistently.
ratings.smashing-it: Identifies ambiguity, explains decisions clearly, escalates potentially unfair processes, and helps maintain consistent treatment.

momentum.expectation: Addresses inconsistencies and reinforces fair treatment across the team.

ratings.needs-work: Accepts avoidable variation, bias, or inconsistent judgement across the team and does not calibrate expectations or decisions.
ratings.great: Addresses inconsistencies and reinforces fair treatment across the team.
ratings.smashing-it: Uses case reviews, feedback, and calibration to identify recurring inconsistency and fixes the team practices or process causing it.

enterprise.expectation: Designs standards and operating models that deliver consistent customer experiences at scale.

ratings.needs-work: Standards vary across channels or locations and exceptions are unmanaged, producing inconsistent or unfair customer outcomes.
ratings.great: Designs standards and operating models that deliver consistent customer experiences at scale.
ratings.smashing-it: Builds principles, controls, and quality measures that maintain fairness and consistency while preserving justified professional judgement.

behaviours.name: Builds lasting trust
behaviours.definition: Acts in ways that strengthen long term customer confidence in the business.

foundations.expectation: Acts honestly and follows through on commitments to customers.

ratings.needs-work: Overpromises, avoids difficult information, fails to follow up, or does not take ownership when the customer experience goes wrong.
ratings.great: Acts honestly and follows through on commitments to customers.
ratings.smashing-it: Sets realistic expectations, communicates changes early, owns service recovery, and leaves the customer clear about what will happen next.

momentum.expectation: Balances customer needs with business outcomes to maintain trust.

ratings.needs-work: Optimises short term operational or commercial results at the expense of fairness, transparency, or long term customer confidence.
ratings.great: Balances customer needs with business outcomes to maintain trust.
ratings.smashing-it: Makes transparent trade offs, coaches the team to protect trust, and uses complaints or recovery situations to strengthen future practice.

enterprise.expectation: Makes trade offs that protect customer trust and the reputation of the business over time.

ratings.needs-work: Customer reputation is considered too late, or incentives and decisions encourage short term outcomes that weaken trust.
ratings.great: Makes trade offs that protect customer trust and the reputation of the business over time.
ratings.smashing-it: Embeds trust into strategy, risk, incentives, and measures, and acts early when decisions or emerging issues could damage long term confidence.

behaviours.name: Sets clear performance goals
behaviours.definition: Defines what success looks like and how it will be measured.

foundations.expectation: Works to agreed goals and understands performance expectations.

ratings.needs-work: Does not understand or work consistently towards agreed expectations, and progress or delivery risks are not raised early.
ratings.great: Works to agreed goals and understands performance expectations.
ratings.smashing-it: Clarifies measures, milestones, and dependencies, tracks progress, and raises risks early enough for action to be taken.

momentum.expectation: Sets clear goals for the team and tracks progress against them.

ratings.needs-work: Team goals are vague, activity based, misaligned, or not reviewed often enough to guide performance.
ratings.great: Sets clear goals for the team and tracks progress against them.
ratings.smashing-it: Sets outcome based goals, aligns ownership and resources, reviews progress frequently, and resets the plan when evidence changes.

enterprise.expectation: Establishes performance priorities and measures that align strategy, effort, and outcomes across the business.

ratings.needs-work: Measures are excessive, conflicting, or disconnected from strategy, creating competing incentives and unclear organisational focus.
ratings.great: Establishes performance priorities and measures that align strategy, effort, and outcomes across the business.
ratings.smashing-it: Creates a coherent performance architecture, links leading and lagging measures, and removes metrics or incentives that drive the wrong behaviour.

behaviours.name: Uses insight and judgement
behaviours.definition: Uses evidence, commercial understanding, and sound judgement to make decisions and improve performance over time.

foundations.expectation: Uses basic operational, customer, and financial information to make sound decisions and adjust own work.

ratings.needs-work: Ignores available operational, customer, or financial information, repeats avoidable mistakes, or makes decisions without checking likely impact.
ratings.great: Uses basic operational, customer, and financial information to make sound decisions and adjust own work.
ratings.smashing-it: Looks for patterns, checks assumptions, explains the decision rationale, tests a practical change, and applies the learning to future work.

momentum.expectation: Reviews operational, customer, people, risk, and financial results to identify patterns, make decisions, and improve team performance.

ratings.needs-work: Reports results without diagnosing causes, relies on a single measure, or makes decisions without considering customer, people, risk, and financial consequences.
ratings.great: Reviews operational, customer, people, risk, and financial results to identify patterns, make decisions, and improve team performance.
ratings.smashing-it: Combines data and stakeholder input, tests likely causes, makes transparent trade offs, and tracks whether decisions improve the intended outcomes.

enterprise.expectation: Uses commercial, market, customer, risk, and financial insight to guide strategy, investment, and performance at scale.

ratings.needs-work: Strategic decisions rely mainly on opinion or siloed data. Commercial, market, customer, risk, or financial implications are not integrated.
ratings.great: Uses commercial, market, customer, risk, and financial insight to guide strategy, investment, and performance at scale.
ratings.smashing-it: Builds enterprise insight loops, separates signal from noise, tests scenarios and assumptions, and reallocates investment or effort based on evidence and post decision learning.

behaviours.name: Delivers sustainable outcomes
behaviours.definition: Balances short term delivery with long term commercial health, customer trust, risk, quality, and capability.

foundations.expectation: Meets targets while following required standards and using resources responsibly.

ratings.needs-work: Meets targets through shortcuts, excessive effort, poor resource use, or reduced quality, or misses results because work is not planned sustainably.
ratings.great: Meets targets while following required standards and using resources responsibly.
ratings.smashing-it: Plans workload, protects standards, uses resources responsibly, flags trade offs early, and finds repeatable ways to deliver rather than relying on one off effort.

momentum.expectation: Balances delivery pressures with quality, risk, customer outcomes, and team capability.

ratings.needs-work: Sacrifices quality, risk, customer outcomes, or team capability for short term delivery, or avoids necessary trade offs and allows all outcomes to deteriorate.
ratings.great: Balances delivery pressures with quality, risk, customer outcomes, and team capability.
ratings.smashing-it: Makes explicit trade offs, protects customer trust and team capacity, builds repeatable delivery, and monitors second order effects rather than only immediate results.

enterprise.expectation: Makes deliberate trade offs across growth, financial performance, customer trust, risk, quality, and capability to deliver sustainable long term outcomes.

ratings.needs-work: Short term targets dominate decisions while hidden costs, customer harm, risk, capability erosion, or weak returns accumulate.
ratings.great: Makes deliberate trade offs across growth, financial performance, customer trust, risk, quality, and capability to deliver sustainable long term outcomes.
ratings.smashing-it: Optimises the portfolio across growth, financial value, customer trust, risk, quality, and capability, uses leading indicators, and corrects course before short term pressure undermines long term performance.
